## FAQ

How does Ditto pair people?

Fill out a questionnaire about your values and what matters to you. After submitting your information, Ditto will text you a date plan that includes the time, place, and details of your match. The date will take place around the campus you're currently near, and we only match up verified college students.

What will I know about my match before the date?

Once we find a good match for you, you'll get a poster with their photos and a short explanation of why you'd be a great pair.

You'll also get a scheduler to share your availability for the week. After both of you fill it out, we'll arrange the date time, place, and give you a few dating tips to help it go smoothly.

What if I don't like my match/date?

You can always simply tell Ditto the reason why you don't like it and any other feedback. Ditto will then proceed to arrange another date that follows the feedback. You can also adjust your profile to update your preferences and personal information.

Who's participating?

Currently, only college students who are 18 or older are participating in this experience.

What if I can't make it last minute?

If you really can't make it last minute, please cancel by texting your match asap to prevent being banned from future experiences.

How long does it usually take?

Since we are only releasing this experience to a very select group of students, we estimate that it will take approximately one to two weeks to secure a guaranteed in-person coffee date. For a recent upgrade in system, 70% of the users now get their first date within 2 days of signing up.

What if I'm not getting Ditto's replies?

Sometimes our lines are busy, and Ditto may not be able to reach you in your current text thread. When that happens, you should start fresh with a new Ditto number.

Your matches, preferences, and account details stay with us, so switching numbers won't reset your profile or anything you've already shared.

...

Where do the dates happen?

Dates take place at carefully selected on-campus spots to ensure a safe and enjoyable experience.

payload.summary: Ditto is a college-focused matchmaking service that pairs verified college students for on-campus coffee dates. How it works: - Tell Ditto your preferences by a weekly deadline. - The “Wednesday Drop” sends you one personalized match and a date plan via iMessage. - Schedule a date that works for both parties and meet on campus. Key features: - Safe, private: only verified students from your school can participate; only your date sees your details; coffee dates on campus. - Real dates delivered: a ready-to-go date invite and a posted rationale for why you’re a good match. - Flexible dating process: you can rate or replace matches, update preferences, and adjust availability. FAQ highlights: - Matches are based on a values questionnaire; you receive a poster with photos and a brief note on why you’d be a good match. - If you dislike a match, you can provide feedback and Ditto will arrange another date; you can also update your profile. - For reliability, dates are arranged within the campus area, and there’s a process to handle missed replies or last-minute cancellations. - Availability: currently limited to select college students (18+); expected to deliver an in-person coffee date within 1–2 weeks, with many users receiving a date within 2 days after signup. Notes: - Enrollment deadline mentioned (9/9/2026) and a large user base (over 183k students; 100+ schools joined). - Dates are coordinated via a scheduled process and typically occur at on-campus spots to ensure safety and convenience.
